message.content:
This is a complete set of earphones, microphones, harness and control box that together form a functioning aviation headset, so it falls under heading 8518. Subheading 8518.30 covers headphones and earphones, whether or not combined with a microphone, and sets consisting of a microphone and one or more loudspeakers. The 10-digit breakout I recall is 8518.30.2000 for "Other," with 8518.30.1000 for line telephone handsets. A noise-cancelling aviation headset with microphones is not a telephone handset, so 8518.30.2000 applies.
